title: bug: Bash VM taskless skip prints a second misleading idle reason
description:
QA hand-forward comment-87cd53fd (M07m3 af8ca2bb): with verified-local and routed mentions but no task, moe-agent.sh prints reason=vm-route then reason=idle ('nothing to answer') from MOE_SKIP_LAUNCH. Confirmed in the launch chain; no host CLI actually runs.
Unify the diagnostic without changing legacy launches; add an assertion to VR-reload/taskless rows. Separate from M07m's approved capacity/credential/job-retry scope; dependency serializes the overlapping wrapper and harness edits.
definitionOfDone: A verified-local taskless iteration emits one accurate no-launch reason even with routed mentions, and never invokes a host CLI.
Legacy taskless diagnostics and launch behavior remain unchanged; focused wrapper rows plus parity pass.
